slots.name: cards
slots.about: copied into state: id (1 up), front, back, pos (the queue place, start it at id), known (false), misses (0)

slots.name: count_line
slots.about: the line under the bar; may read known_count, left_count and total

slots.name: tap_text
slots.about: the faint line on the card before the answer shows

slots.name: seen_text
slots.about: the tag on a card that was missed before and came round again

slots.name: grade_ask
slots.about: the question over the two grade buttons

slots.name: done_title
slots.about: the heading once every card is known

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the line under it; may read total, first_try and hardest (the front of the most-missed card, or "")

slots.name: reveal
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: shows the card's back; the label is the show button's words

slots.name: no
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: not remembered: the card goes to the back of the queue

slots.name: yes
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: remembered: the card is known

slots.name: again
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: the whole deck again

empty.shows: empty_note only; no bar, card or buttons

attention.shows: seen_text on the card, in words, when a missed card comes round again

fallback.shows: a check, done_title, done_line with first-try count and the hardest card, and the again button

labels.card_btn: the front, and the back once shown

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, smooth, swap and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: no and yes carry a cross and a check with their words; a card seen again says so in words
